item.description: Victims’ commissioner welcomes strengthening of law in England and Wales but calls for measures to tackle convicted stalkers Ministers will create a new stalking offence so that victims will no longer have to prove fear or distress to seek protection under the law, the Home Office has announced. Under current laws, the underlying offence of harassment in England and Wales, as well as additional factors such as the victim’s alarm, must be established for it to be considered stalking. The new law, alongside other changes, will focus on the perpetrator’s behaviour instead, officials said… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Social media making it harder for UK parents to raise families, survey finds
item.description: Poll of parents of young children finds three-quarters think pressure from influencers has increased their anxiety Parents of children aged five and under say pressure from social media influencers to be “the perfect parent” is making it harder to raise a family, according to a survey . Three-quarters (76%) of those who took part in the UK-wide poll agreed social media had increased anxiety around parenting, while three out of five (59%) complained of “impossible expectations” and “feeling judged”.
